about: The carrying ogre's walk is one entry of the global swap store. harness_art_world's world.walk_carry (128 x 128) is overwritten by a LATER mod's ogre.carry.walk swap (36 x 52, last loaded wins), and a class's own ogre.carry.walk swap (24 x 40) beats the global entry whichever wrote it. Mods load by folder name: world < world_carry < world_class. The other order (world after a swap) is in art_world_forms.
expect_mod_errors: spr_hobgoblin_carry has 10 frames, it must keep 8
at another size xorig and yorig are required
spr_hobgoblin_log has 2 frames, it must keep 1
